description: Export as TIFF (File > Export > Export As > TIFF): colour model, resolution, anti-aliasing, LZW compression, byte order, ICC profile, one file per artboard

artboards.description: Artboards to export, 1-based like Illustrator: "1", "1-3,5". Default all

colorModel.description: rgb, cmyk or grayscale. Default the document's colour mode

embedIccProfile.description: Embed the colour profile. Default false

resolution.description: Pixels per inch: 72 screen, 150 medium, 300 high. Default 150

useArtboards.description: One file per artboard (Illustrator adds the artboard name). False exports all artwork as one image. Default true

name: export_tiff
title: Export Tiff
